profile.title: Your profile
profile.intro: How the screens look for you, and your password.

setPassword.subject: Your Shakti Prime sign-in
setPassword.body:
Hello {name},

Your Shakti Prime access is ready. Open this link to choose your password:
{url}

The link works for one day. If you didn't expect this email, you can ignore it.

Shakti Prime

resetPassword.subject: Choose a new Shakti Prime password
resetPassword.body:
Hello {name},

Open this link to choose a new password for Shakti Prime:
{url}

The link works for one hour, and only the newest link works. If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays as it is.

Shakti Prime

signInAttempts.subject: Someone tried to sign in to your Shakti Prime account
signInAttempts.body:
Hello {name},

Someone has entered a wrong password for your Shakti Prime account several times. If it was you, there is nothing to do. If it wasn't, tell your manager today and change your password from the home screen.

Shakti Prime

twoFactorReset.subject: Your Shakti Prime authenticator app was reset
twoFactorReset.body:
Hello {name},

An Executive has reset the authenticator app on your Shakti Prime account, and you have been signed out everywhere. Sign in again with your password and set up the authenticator app on your phone when Shakti Prime asks you to. If you didn't ask for this, tell your manager today.

Shakti Prime

Each colour shows how readable it is on a card: text needs 4.5 or more (7 with higher contrast), lines and icons need 3 or more (4.5 with higher contrast).
